verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment isolated from production is a fair capability to ask of a SaaS CRM platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, developer edition, or staging org. The option to suppress workflow triggers on insert (zoho-crm-docs-14) is a related control, not an isolated environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
